name: Phantasmal Resonance
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting, sonic]; Level bard 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/4 levels
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a painful, phantasmal ringing in the target’s ears. They take a -10 penalty to Perception checks related to hearing and take 2d6 sonic damage at the beginning of each of their turns. A successful Will save reduces the duration to 1 round.
